## سير عمل الوكلاء — Agent workflows & orchestration

#### ABUILD-01 · تنفيذ خارطة الطريق تلقائياً: مرحلة لكل طلب دمج · Autonomous phase-per-PR roadmap execution loop · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قيادة خارطة طريق معتمدة ذات مراحل حتى النهاية دون إشراف: وكيل منفذ معزول لكل مرحلة، وطلب دمج مشروط بنجاح CI والمراجع الآلي، ثم الدمج بعد مهلة وتحديث اللوحات وتسلسل المرحلة التالية. — Drive an approved phased roadmap to completion unattended with one isolated implementer subagent per phase, each PR gated on CI and the review bot, merged after a grace window, then dashboards updated and the next phase chained.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** An approved roadmap with per-phase task files exists; 'run autopilot'; overnight multi-phase build; any unattended loop that needs finite limits and stop conditions.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Preflight in every mode: gh installed and authenticated, git base branch reachable on origin, roadmap with progress dashboard plus per-phase task files, a config doc present, declared external tools up; refuse rather than invent plans. 2) init mode writes the config from the roadmap, then STOPS for human review. 3) run: orchestrator spawns one isolated implementer per phase, opens a PR, waits for CI and review bot via background wake-ups, fixes findings, merges only when the full merge gate holds after a grace window, updates dashboards, chains the next phase. 4) Declare finite loop limits and termination conditions up front; stop on any unmet precondition. **أرقام / params:** mode (init|run|status); roadmap path; grace window; loop limits; retry-watchdog env for unattended sessions
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0 / MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/899-bymax-codex/2087-autopilot` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3407-clean-room/13957-clean-room-loop` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3111-constellation/13312-roundloop`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): bymax-codex/autopilot (#2087); clean-room/clean-room-loop (#13957); constellation/roundloop (#13312) · theme agent-workflow · 8 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/899-bymax-codex/2087-autopilot, skills/3407-clean-room/13957-clean-room-loop, skills/3111-constellation/13312-roundloop

#### ABUILD-03 · خط وكلاء بأدوار ومراحل وأقفال كتابة واستئناف · Role-squad agent pipeline with stages, locks and resume · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يشغّل فريق وكلاء بأدوار (مطوّر ومراجع خصم ومختبر جودة) بخطة معماري عبر بوابات مراحل وأقفال كتابة واستئناف يبدأ بالتحقق، مع تنسيق بالرسائل وسجل مشترك. — Run an architect-planned team of role agents (developer, adversarial reviewer, QA) through staged gates with write locks and verify-first resume, coordinating via messages and a shared log.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User wants an agent team on a repo's open issues, role-based specialist analysis (researcher, architect, PM), or to configure Claude Code agent teams with lead/teammates and messaging.
- **كيف / how:** 1) An architect pass sorts outstanding issues into parallelizable groups. 2) Each issue gets a small squad: developer, adversarial reviewer, QA/SDET. 3) Define stages and gates; hold write locks so two roles never edit the same artifact. 4) Specialist deep-dive: researcher, architect and PM run in parallel and yield a prioritized next-build report. 5) Coordinate with SendMessage/TaskUpdate and ring a 'doorbell' instead of pasting payloads; log traffic as JSONL. 6) Show run status (stages, roles, locks, gates); resume an interrupted run verify-first. **أرقام / params:** repo and issue list; role set; stage gates; capacity
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3263-agent-team-orchestration/13774-agent-team-orchestration` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3605-ateam/14480-run` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2134-agent-patterns-plugin/7563-agent-teams`

#### ABUILD-04 · تفكيك المواصفة إلى مهام صغيرة لوكلاء البرمجة · Spec-to-task decomposition for coding agents · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحوّل مواصفة أو خطة إلى مهام صغيرة قابلة للتحقق مع الاعتماديات وعلامات التوازي وفحوص الإنجاز ومستويات الاستقلالية وجدول تغطية معايير القبول. — Turn a spec or plan into small, verifiable agent tasks with dependencies, parallel markers, done-checks, autonomy levels and an acceptance-criteria coverage table.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User has a spec/PRD/plan to hand to coding agents, wants work split for parallel sessions or worktrees, or an agent drifts and fails on tasks that are too large.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read spec and plan; list deliverables (endpoints, components, migrations, jobs, docs). 2) Order phases: setup -> contracts/tests -> core -> integration -> polish. 3) Size each task to one verifiable outcome, about 1-4 human hours or a diff reviewable in under 15 minutes, touching a small named file set; split any task needing 'and also'. 4) Write each as `T-07 [P] title` with Covers (FR/AC ids), Depends on, Files, Done when (a test or command), Autonomy level. 5) Mark [P] only for disjoint files with no unmerged dependency. 6) Name the critical path and tasks needing a human decision. 7) Emit tasks.md with a coverage table; drop tasks with no source requirement. **أرقام / params:** spec/plan path; autonomy policy; parallel-session limit
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3050-adlc-intent/13136-task-decomposition` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2230-ai-coding-model-guidance/8467-coding-agent-task-scoping` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2139-blueprint-plugin/7620-blueprint-work-order`

#### ABUILD-05 · مسار توقيع وإصدار تطبيقات الجوال والمكتب · Mobile and desktop release signing pipeline · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم التوقيع والتوثيق والطرح المرحلي والتحديث الآمن لتطبيقات الجوال والمكتب. — Design code signing, notarization, staged rollout and safe auto-update for mobile and desktop apps.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Setting up CI releases or diagnosing signing failures.
- **كيف / how:** 1) iOS: Fastlane match for certs, Android: keystore kept out of repo. 2) macOS: Developer ID, hardened runtime, notarytool then staple; Windows: Authenticode, EV cert. 3) Keys in CI secrets. 4) Updater verifies signature, uses channels, staged rollout, rollback, version floor. 5) Pick Electron vs Tauri by real needs. **أرقام / params:** platform

#### ABUILD-14 · حلقة مراجع شجرة الوصولية لتحكم المتصفح · Accessibility-tree ref loop for browser agents · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تشغيل متصفح حقيقي عبر لقطات شجرة وصولية مختصرة ومراجع عناصر، مع إعادة اللقطة بعد كل تغيير. — Drive a real browser by taking compact accessibility snapshots with element refs, acting on refs, and re-snapshotting after each DOM change.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Task needs clicking/filling/scraping a live JS-rendered page cheaply in tokens.
- **كيف / how:** 1) open URL (daemon starts Chrome). 2) snapshot interactive elements with bounded output. 3) click/fill by ref (@eN or eN), not CSS. 4) re-snapshot after any DOM change since refs move. 5) read text with a size cap. 6) screenshot only for visual or canvas checks. 7) close the session. Chain commands or batch to reuse the daemon. **أرقام / params:** url, output cap, session name
- **تثبيت / install:** `npm i -g agent-browser && agent-browser install`

#### ABUILD-24 · ضبط مجمع الاتصالات وموثوقية قاعدة البيانات · Connection pool sizing and DB reliability playbook · 📄 موصوف / documented only

#### ABUILD-25 · نص نسخ احتياطي لقاعدة البيانات مع الاحتفاظ والتشفير · Database backup script with retention and encryption · 📄 موصوف / documented only

#### ABUILD-51 · صياغة التذاكر وأوصاف PR بهيكل ماذا/لماذا/كيف · What/Why/How ticket and PR drafting · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب جسم تذكرة أو بلاغ خطأ أو وصف PR بثلاثة أقسام ثابتة ولغة محايدة إيجابية بلا وعود. — Writes an issue, bug report or PR body in three fixed sections with neutral, affirmative wording and no unbacked claims.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** كتابة issue أو وصف PR أو مهمة إعادة هيكلة / drafting an issue, bug report, PR description or migration task
- **كيف / how:** 1) What: 1-3 sentences on the subject, with links to related issues and official docs. 2) Why: the problem or opportunity and its background, linked to the discussion. 3) How: one concrete action per bullet, in order, ending in verifiable acceptance criteria. 4) Say what to do rather than what to avoid; state facts without superlatives, percentages or time estimates. 5) Before posting check every link resolves and the Markdown renders; read the repo's PR template first. **أرقام / params:** type: feature|bug|refactor
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ABUILD-52 · فرز أعطال الاتصال حسب مجال الخطأ دون تغيير الإعدادات · Fault-domain connectivity triage without touching config · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحدد مكان عطل الشبكة (الشبكة المحلية، DNS، المسار، الخدمة نفسها) بأقل الأدلة وبأوامر قراءة فقط. — Localises a live connectivity failure to LAN, DNS, upstream path or the remote service with bounded, read-only probes.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** API أو خادم MCP ينقطع، DNS متقلب، فقدان حزم / an API or MCP server times out, DNS is flaky, calls drop packets
- **كيف / how:** 1) Record the exact affected host/URL, start time, continuous or intermittent, and whether other sites work. 2) Compare a 5-packet ping to a known local target with one to the destination (never invent a gateway). 3) Separate resolver configuration (scutil --dns / resolvectl) from query behaviour (dig +time=2 +tries=1). 4) Bounded traceroute -n -q 1 -m 20 only if path visibility reduces doubt; a silent hop is not a broken hop. 5) Time the real endpoint with curl -w dns/connect/tls/ttfb/total and timeouts. 6) Label each line Observed / Inferred / Unknown and return one fault domain with low/medium/high confidence plus the single next safest check; no restarts, DNS flushes or firewall edits during diagnosis. **أرقام / params:** host, symptom window
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3494-incident-response/14217-connectivity-triage`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas frontier mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): incident-response/connectivity-triage (#14217) · theme productivity-integrations · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/3494-incident-response/14217-connectivity-triage
